newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DUNDEE EARMARKED FOR PLACE IN GERMAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUNDEE EARMARKED FOR PLACE IN GERMAN SQUAD.

text.p: South African-born striker Sean Dundee, who only recently gained a German passport through a special fast-track system, is set to be called into Berti Vogts's national soccer squad for the first time.

Vogts has confirmed that the Karlsruhe player, the Bundesliga's top scorer in the first half of the season, will be named in Germany's squad for a friendly against Israel on February 26, German newspapers reported on Saturday.
Dundee applied for German citizenship using a special fast-track method reserved for cases of "public interest".
His decision to apply for a German passport sparked outrage in his native country where some politicians accused him of turning his back on South Africa and called for the move to be blocked.
